article.story: Phoenix Suns vs. Portland Trail Blazers Portland, Oregon; Wednesday, 10 p.m. EDT LINE: Trail Blazers -3.5; over/under is 232.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Portland Trail Blazers host the Phoenix Suns for the season opener. Portland finished 42-40 overall, 29-23 in Western Conference action and 24-17 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Trail Blazers averaged 8.3 steals, 5.5 blocks and 16.5 turnovers per game last season. Phoenix went 45-37 overall and 29-23 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Suns averaged 112.6 points per game while shooting 45.5% from the field and 36.1% from behind the arc last season. INJURIES: Trail Blazers: Shaedon Sharpe: out (meniscus). Suns: Mark Williams: out (shoulder). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
